source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The reland restores the nine original task/artifact/signing file blobs and adds a two-line Linux ARM nightly mozconfig. The original and backout lack that path; the accepted file has the identical reland blob. The original task already selected nightly configuration and the Linux ARM platform. Commit prose attributes build bustage to the missing file, but this scoped check proves only the file/configuration delta, not a fresh build or upstream resolver result.
title: The AArch64 reland adds the missing Linux nightly mozconfig beside restored task blobs
